exits.src: Close the entire spread by 21 DTE at the latest. The last three weeks add almost no profit and all of the assignment risk.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: the short call is ITM by design, so check extrinsic value daily. If short-leg extrinsic < $0.15, close the spread the same session.

DIVIDEND GUARD (critical for this structure): close the entire spread the session before any ex-dividend date whenever short-leg extrinsic < 1.5 * dividend. Deep ITM short calls on dividend payers are the single most commonly assigned option in the whole family.

safety_gaps.why: the structure has 1 short leg(s) and no compiled assignment guard. These are AMERICAN options on shares: a short that finishes in the money delivers 100 shares per contract the account never sized for.
the document names a stop and none compiled. A strategy that looks armed and is missing its stop is the failure this whole pipeline exists to prevent.
